notes: «جميعا عن وكيع» is co-transmission: Abu Bakr and Zuhayr share one level (rule 2)
The dash gloss «- قال زهير حدثنا وكيع، -» is the compiler's aside, a Zuhayr wording of the same level, left out (rule 1)
«أبيه» is Abu Juhayfa, the Companion whose words are the saying; the text does not name him here, so the relation is kept
